_about: Every section the website's facility and company pages can print, and where the mobile app (kidsoverprofits/kids-over-profits-mobile) shows it. scripts/test-app-parity.php fails when a template prints a section not listed here, or when a listed app section is missing from the app's section list (src/components/facility/model.ts presentSections(), src/components/operator/model.ts sectionsOf()). "app": the app's section id. "todo": not in the app yet, with what porting it needs; each todo is an open item in docs/plan/4.8-app.md. "skip": never in the app, with the reason. "app_file": look for "app" (as written) in that app file instead of the section list, for a piece that is not a section (a box under the summary). Sections made by helpers outside the templates ("helper") are listed by hand: the test cannot see them.

podcast-statements.skip: administrators only on the website (machine transcripts, "listen before quoting"); the app's pages are public

profile-prose.helper: a Facility Profile post (kop_mobile_profile_post(): merged into Hyde School's page, the page itself for the other 14)

documents:research.helper: research naming the program, under Documents ($page['research'])

outside-research.helper: kop_outside_research_render(), the box under the summary (payload 'outside_research')
